tasks.title: Critical problem with marking invoices as paid manually
tasks.notes: Production orders 2970 and 2975 show the bug. Manual 'mark as paid' doesn't register the payment — order stays in first-invoice-just-sent state.

prep.what: Fix the manual payment registration flow: when a user marks an invoice paid manually (client paid outside QB), the system must create a PaymentRecord and advance the order status.
prep.understand: QB auto-detects most payments. The manual path (client paid by cash/wire) triggers 'mark as paid' but currently skips PaymentRecord creation — leaving the order stuck in first-invoice-sent state. Orders 2970 and 2975 are live repro cases you can inspect right now.
approach: Open orders 2970 and 2975 in production or staging to see the stuck state first-hand
Trace the 'mark as paid' controller action through the service layer — find exactly where PaymentRecord creation is absent
Insert `PaymentRecord` creation + the `InvoiceSent → Paid` order status transition in the manual payment code path
Test end-to-end: manually mark a new test invoice as paid and confirm both the PaymentRecord and order status update correctly
resources: Production orders 2970 and 2975 (live repro cases)
QuickBooks auto-payment sync path (comparison reference — how it does PaymentRecord creation)
Order status state machine definition (confirms the correct target state after manual payment)
`PaymentRecord` model and creation pattern
